plainLanguage: Court inaweza kuamuru convicted person kulipa costs zinazohusiana na prosecution yote au sehemu yake, lakini power hiyo iko subject to limitations za section 345 ya Criminal Procedure Act.
meaning: Section 32 ni cross-reference sentencing/costs provision. Conviction peke yake haimaanishi costs lazima ziorderwe. Neno 'may' linaonyesha judicial discretion, na discretion hiyo imewekewa limitations na CPA section 345.
keyPoints: Court may order costs of whole or part of prosecution.
Costs can include matters incidental to prosecution within lawful scope.
Power is subject to CPA section 345 limitations.

legalTerms.meaning: Gharama ambazo court inaweza kuorder kwa statutory authority relating to prosecution.
Gharama zinazohusiana na prosecution kwa namna inayotambuliwa na applicable law.

examples.title: Prosecution costs requested
examples.scenario: Baada ya conviction, prosecution inaomba order ya costs.
examples.analysis: Court lazima itumie section 32 pamoja na CPA section 345; conviction yenyewe haitoshi kufanya order automatic.

history.summary: The Penal Code keeps the costs power expressly subordinate to Criminal Procedure Act limitations.
notes: Do not quote section 32 without its CPA cross-reference.
Current CPA text should be checked for live litigation.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: The word 'may' requires a judicial decision; costs are not a mandatory consequence of every conviction.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: The Penal Code itself signals that the CPA supplies boundaries, so an explanation that omits section 345 is incomplete.

debateQuestion: Ni prosecution costs zipi zinaombwa, na CPA section 345 limitations zinaruhusu court kuziorder kwa kiwango gani?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
